title: Does grounding a writer in real sources help?
statement: Does giving a question writer real source texts, so that it writes only the questions, raise item quality?
example: Under one judge a grounded trial passed 5 of 6 items, but on the binding grader the result collapsed to about 28%.
detail: An earlier AP question-generation effort reported grounding its writer in real source texts as a win on a six-item smoke test, 5/6 passing at 0.85 and a mean of 0.953 against 0.29, and recorded its confirmation on the real grader as blocked (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0063-aptraining-prior-exploration.qmd`). A later insight entry found the 0.29→0.95 jump existed only under a discredited judge and collapsed to ~28% on the binding grader (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/knowledge/kb-0064-insight-stimulus-provenance-unlock.qmd`), and the reading project's item standard calls real-source provenance a separate, unproven lever (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/item-quality.md`). The reading project's generator assessment calls it the one mechanism that effort found that broke a wall, and its generator plans are built around it: feed real stimuli and let the model write only the questions (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/courses/g5-reading/analysis/GENERATOR_ASSESSMENT.md`; `grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g5-reading-generator-output-spec.md`).
against: The same standard still has the model write only the questions where a genuine source exists (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/pr-proposals/ti-courseplans-standards/staged/docs/standards/item-quality.md`, lines 41-42), and the generator handoff calls source grounding the biggest real lever (`grade3-reading/knowledge_bot/handoffs/g5-reading-generator-output-spec.md`, line 74): the practice is kept while its measured gain is not.

evidence.quote: **The recent "source-grounding breaks the wall" win is smoke only** (n=6, Unit-1: 5/6 pass@0.85, mean 0.953 vs 0.29)
real-grader confirmation of an uncached served KC is BLOCKED.
That **0.29→0.95** jump existed only under a **discredited Gemini judge**. On the **binding grader** it **collapsed to ~28%** (DBQ 0%, MCQ_SET 0%) and was logged as a **"Gemini-judge artifact."**

(Real-source provenance is a *separate, UNPROVEN* lever: the aptraining "0.29→0.95 via real passages" result was **refuted** on the binding grader. Do not relabel machine-authored cold passages as "real.")
Where a genuine source exists, the model writes the questions, not the passage.
Feed the model real/cold G5-band stimuli and let it write **only the questions**; don't have it invent the passage from nothing.
it's the one mechanism aptraining found that broke a wall (n=6 smoke, 5/6 pass@0.85).
**Source-grounding was the biggest real lever** (feed real stimuli, model writes the questions) — exactly the cold-passage/anti-leak standard in §3. Build the generator around it.
